videos.title: Drupal 8 Theming - Part 04 - Blocks and Regions
videos.description: This video covers Drupal 8 theming, focusing on how to set up and manage regions. It explains how to add and arrange blocks of content within these defined regions on a Drupal site, detailing their functionality and administrative processes.

videos.title: How to Create a Drupal 7 Slideshow with Views: Tutorial 1 of 2
videos.description: This Drupal 7 tutorial demonstrates how to build an image slideshow using Views. It covers creating a content type, configuring image styles, and integrating modules like Views Slideshow and Chaos Tools, along with jQuery Cycle, to establish the slideshow functionality.

videos.title: ✅ How to Install Drupal 9 on Windows 10 Localhost with XAMPP
videos.description: This video provides a step-by-step tutorial on installing Drupal 9 on a Windows 10 localhost environment. It details the setup process for Drupal content management software using the XAMPP server.
